profile: Sustainability data specialist with five years of experience turning packaging, product and emissions datasets into auditable regulatory outputs. Combines Extended Producer Responsibility and PPWR compliance advisory with data collection, validation and quality assurance across large multi-entity datasets, and builds the methodologies, assumptions and audit trails that make client reporting defensible. Models EPR fee and cost exposure per market for manufacturing clients, and acted as primary data contact for more than 150 organisations on the leading global environmental disclosure platform.

Presented analysis results and regulatory developments at senior leadership level and derived the resulting recommendations
